init.title: 管理監測城市 / Manage Cities
init.description:
勾選要監測的城市，每個城市會建立 13 個 sensor：4 個預報（天氣狀況、降雨機率、最低溫、最高溫）與 9 個測站即時觀測（天氣、氣溫、濕度、氣壓、風速、風向、今日雨量、今日最高／最低溫）。儲存後整合會自動重新載入。

⚠️ 至少需保留一個城市；若要完全移除整合，請到「設定 → 裝置與服務」刪除整合。

Select the cities to monitor. Each city creates 13 sensors: 4 forecast (weather, rain probability, min/max temperature) and 9 live station observations (weather, temperature, humidity, pressure, wind speed/direction, precipitation today, today's high/low). Changes take effect after reloading.

⚠️ At least one city must remain selected. To remove the integration entirely, delete it from Settings → Devices & Services.

confirm_remove.title: 確認移除 / Confirm Removal
confirm_remove.description:
⚠️ 以下城市將被移除，對應的裝置與 sensor 也會一併刪除。此動作無法復原。

The following cities will be removed, along with their devices and sensors. This cannot be undone.

{cities}

按「提交」確認，或返回取消。
Press Submit to confirm, or go back to cancel.
